shared_style.art_style: Monochrome hand-drawn food-brand illustration: contemporary indie food identity expressed through black ink linework, simplified silhouettes, playful human or anthropomorphic storytelling, and generous white space.
not_quite: not Japanese kawaii as the main influence

linework.common: black contour drawing with occasional interior marks
linework.range: fine architectural ink in image 1 to bold rounded outline in image 4

forms.range: isometric geometry in image 1, mascot bodies in image 2, emblem curves in image 3, retail objects in image 4

composition.common: single compact centered subject with clear space
composition.range: logo lockups in images 1-3, horizontal scene in image 4

personality.range: eccentric in image 1, social in image 2, energetic in image 3, welcoming in image 4

typography.range: large roof lettering in image 1, supporting wordmark in image 2, reverse lowercase emblem lettering in image 3

recommended_direction.name: Playful Monochrome Neighborhood Food Illustration
recommended_direction.core_formula: one bold, memorable food or vendor silhouette + imperfect black ink contour + one custom hand-lettered identifier + generous white space
recommended_direction.choose_for_primary_identity: Image 2 if you want maximum personality and mascot potential; image 3 if you want a cleaner emblem that scales better; image 4 if you want warmth and a human neighborhood story.
recommended_direction.hybrid_to_explore: Use image 4's welcoming vendor scene, image 2's expressive character language, image 3's strong dark anchor shape, and image 1's tiny architectural micro-details.
avoid: adding color before the black-and-white silhouette works
font-based logo treatment without custom drawing

composition.name: silhouette-first
composition.value: subject remains legible without interior detail

texture.name: ink-imperfection
texture.value: subtle stroke irregularity and uneven spacing

unresolved_questions: The original production methods are unknown: these could be vector drawings, scanned ink, or screen-printed artwork.
The desired balance between mascot, emblem, and scene illustration still needs to be chosen.
